description: This file defines internal implementation details, data structures, and utility functions related to a dictionary (Dict) type used within the ATen framework of PyTorch. It includes class definitions, template functions for type conversions, hash function specializations, and comparison operators for Dict and IValue objects.

classes.name: c10::detail::DictKeyEqualTo
classes.description: Functor class for comparing two IValue objects for key equality, with special handling for tensors to compare by identity.

classes.name: c10::detail::DictKeyHash
classes.description: Functor class for hashing IValue objects used as keys in Dict, with type-specific hash implementations.

classes.name: c10::impl::DictImpl
classes.description: Internal class representing the implementation of a dictionary, including copying functionality.

classes.name: c10::Dict
classes.description: Template class for a key-value dictionary used in ATen, supporting insertion, deletion, lookup, and type queries.
